inlines.v: WOODY, adjective [from wood.] 1. Abounding with wood; as woody land; a woody region. --Secret shades of woody Idas inmost grove. 2. Consisting of wood; ligneous; as the woody parts of plants. 3. Pertaining to woods; sylvan; as woody nymphs.
